findings.description: Each of the four new #106 cases goes red when the production code path it exercises is mutated in a cp -a copy of the working tree, and green on the unmutated tree.
findings.evidence: Copy: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-k-arnett-repos-agent-guild/7188fa38-b39f-46d7-9b46-9e5e2fe93992/scratchpad/{mut,mutb,mutc}, each a fresh `cp -a /Users/k.arnett/repos/agent-guild/.`; the job branch was never edited. Baseline (pristine tree): '4 passed, 0 failed'. Mutation A, codex-courier.py:431 'for attempt in range(2)' -> 'range(1)' (retry removed): '0 passed, 4 failed' -- e.g. 'FAIL ... retried exactly once, then stops  attempts=None calls=1'. Mutation B, structured-output parse gate bypassed by salvaging the truncated prefix in _validate_structured_output (codex-courier.py:345-348): '3 passed, 1 failed', the first case red with 'outcome_verdict=blocked desc=... failed verdict validation at timestamp: required field missing'. Mutation C, codex-courier.py:586 '_should_keep_raw(...)' -> 'False' (raw retention disabled): '3 passed, 1 failed', only the retention case red with 'raw_path=None entries=0'. Cases evaluated in isolation via scratchpad/case106.py, whose four conditions are transcribed verbatim from the committed test block, because under mutation A the suite crashes at test_codex_courier.py:503 before reaching the #106 block. C-5's backstop is satisfied: the artifact list names test_codex_courier.py, which carries the tests for the behavior C-6 requires.

findings.description: All four live acceptance criteria are demonstrated by a replay I re-ran myself, the posted output matches what I observe claim by claim, and the amended criterion is recorded as a deliberate #142/#144 amendment with its info finding.
findings.evidence: Independent driver (scratchpad/replay.py) loads only the harness fixtures from test_codex_courier.py and drives malformed_quotes itself. Observed: persisted block identical to the comment's -- {"verdict_path": ".agent-guild/state/verdicts/T-054-sonnet-r0-codex.json", ..., "raw_path": ".agent-guild/state/log/courier-raw/T-054-sonnet-r0-codex.jsonl", "ledger_appended": true, "sentinel_path": null}. AC1: stem holds a blocked verdict and 'validate-verdict.py rc: 0 / OK: ... is a conforming verdict'. AC2: 'outcome.attempts: 2' and fake-CLI invocation count 2. AC3: finding description byte-identical to the comment's, 'codex structured output remained invalid after one retry: codex output was not JSON: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 1 column 243 (char 242)', with the unparsed payload in evidence. AC4: raw log has 2 lines, both output_file values containing the literal '"C-1 must pass"'. Reproducing block verified: `python3 .agent-guild/scripts/test_codex_courier.py` prints the four quoted 'ok #106:' lines and '46 passed, 0 failed'. Production-crossing claims verified independently: T-001-haiku-r0-codex.jsonl holds 2 attempts whose checker fields are 'checker-second-opinion' then 'second-opinion-attacker', and the stem verdict's blocker finding carries exactly 8554 bytes of evidence, as the comment states. The vacuity claims reproduce: retry removal reds all four cases, retention removal reds only the retention case, a permissive decoder reds only the first. Amendment recorded under '### The Fourth Criterion Changed On Purpose' naming #142/#144 and the info finding; the mechanism is real -- codex-courier.py:383-389 authors that info finding, and the live T-001 verdict carries one: "courier runner: the far side echoed model='gpt-5'; the lane ran 'gpt-5.6-terra'".

findings.description: The AC 1 code block is presented as the output of `python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(...))"` but shows pretty-printed JSON with the `findings` key silently dropped, so the transcript is not literally what that command prints.
findings.evidence: scratchpad/comment.md:35-44 shows the shell prompt line then a block ending '"verdict": "blocked", "timestamp": ..., "duration_ms": null, "cost_usd": null}' with no findings array; my run of the same command on the same stem returns the object including the findings array (replay.py '=== stem contents ==='). The substance is unaffected -- the finding is quoted in full under AC 3 -- and every claim reproduces, so this is a transcript-fidelity blemish, not an unreproducible claim. Related and equally minor: the comment labels raw retention 'AC 4' while the issue's own fourth AC is the re-serialization one addressed under a differently titled section, so 'the fourth criterion' names two different things in one comment.

findings.description: Scoped to 9985472..HEAD (commit 6720a5a) and the posted comment, the prose says why the change exists, carries no enumerated AI-writing tell, keeps every heading title-cased, and holds one logical change per commit.
findings.evidence: 6720a5a subject 'test(courier): replay #106's embedded-quote payload, not just NOT_JSON' names the cause, and the body states it outright: 'The suite's existing malformed fixture emits NOT_JSON, which fails at character one and never reaches the partway-parse case'. Typographic rules: 0 em dashes in either the commit message or the comment, so none can be spaced; all seven comment headings are title-cased ('## Verified By Replay', '### The Payload', '### Driving It Through The Courier', '### The Fourth Criterion Changed On Purpose', '### The Same Path In Production', '### Checking The Test Isn't Vacuous', '### Reproducing'). Regex scans of scratchpad/{msg.txt,comment.md} for inflated symbolism (crucial|pivotal|testament|underscores|serves as), vague attribution (experts|many believe|some argue), '-ing' editorial tack-ons (, ensuring|making|highlighting|...), and 'It's not X, it's Y' return zero hits in both. The four-item list in the commit body ('caught rather than truncated, retried exactly once, a schema-conforming blocked verdict at the lane stem, and both discarded attempts retained') is not padded to three. Granularity: 6720a5a carries the new test case plus the packages build-plugin.py regenerated from it, which C-2 requires in the same commit, and nothing else. No Co-Authored-By or generated-with trailer.

findings.description: The comment leans on the 'X rather than Y' construction five times in about a thousand words, which reads as a tic on a close read even though it is not one of the tells the clause enumerates.
findings.evidence: scratchpad/comment.md: 'driven back through that code ... rather than an argument from line numbers'; 'the vendor side's tally rather than the runner's self-report'; 'That is a decision rather than a regression'; 'It failed on identity rather than on embedded quotes'; 'This stays open rather than closed'. Each contrast does real work in its own sentence and none is the 'not X, it's Y' inversion C-10 names, so the clause is met; recorded because a sixth would tip it.

findings.description: Work is on chore/courier-lane-cleanup with no upstream tracking ref, and nothing outside .agent-guild/state/ is left uncommitted.
findings.evidence: $ .agent-guild/scripts/check-build.sh 'git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | grep -qx chore/courier-lane-cleanup ...; git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name "@{u}" ... && exit 1; d=$(git status --porcelain | cut -c4- | grep -v "^\.agent-guild/state/"); test -z "$d" ...' -> 'check-build.sh: exit 0'. Corroborated directly: `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u}` -> 'fatal: no upstream configured for branch chore/courier-lane-cleanup', and `git status --porcelain` prints nothing at all.
